The '''Worldbreaker Monolith''' was a gargantuan [[Monolith]] that existed on the surface of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] sometime after the [[Invasion of Ziost|eradication]] of all life on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. Eventually it was killed around the same time as the nearby [[Colossal Monolith]].<ref name="TOR" />
